subject.title: Control UI: upload agent avatars from Agents tab

question: Should OpenClaw add a workspace-persistent Agents-tab avatar upload RPC/UI, and what storage, validation, auth, and identity-precedence policy should it use?
rationale: The missing feature is clear, but the implementation crosses a new file-upload and workspace-write boundary that automation should not define without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve bounded upload design
options.body: Add a narrow authenticated upload path that stores validated image files under the agent workspace, updates canonical identity metadata, and keeps existing read-only avatar-route protections.

options.title: Keep browser-local override only
options.body: Keep Quick Settings local overrides and manual CLI/IDENTITY.md paths while avoiding a new server-side upload surface.

options.title: Defer core upload
options.body: Leave this as a broader Control UI identity-management product decision instead of adding a one-off upload RPC now.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded upload design
recommendation.body: Add a narrow authenticated upload path that stores validated image files under the agent workspace, updates canonical identity metadata, and keeps existing read-only avatar-route protections.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest combined history across avatar support, Control UI avatar serving, and gateway safety boundaries.
